materials.pressure_sensors: MEMS piezoresistive (silicon die, medical-grade epoxy encapsulation)
materials.shunt_body: Existing eShunt material (pebax/silicone composite per CereVasc spec)
materials.asic: Custom CMOS ASIC in hermetic ceramic package

manufacturing_process: Sensor die attach + wirebond + epoxy encapsulation onto existing eShunt catheter during assembly
integration_with_eshunt: Sensors mounted at proximal (CSF) and distal (venous) ends of existing eShunt; ASIC embedded in catheter wall

failure_modes.mitigation: Auto-zero calibration on power-up; drift compensation algorithm
Redundant routing; fail-safe mode uses single sensor
Anti-fouling coating (parylene-C); differential measurement compensates for common-mode fouling

safety_constraints: No energized components in CSF contact (sensors are passively isolated)
ISO 10993 biocompatibility for all CSF-contact materials
MRI conditional (sensors must function in 1.5T/3T MRI)
